_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Mithu uka Snake ku {width}×{height} dikwesa.
O kontrolla mithu {player_id}. Mbinu zinazohitajika: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kana w/s/a/d).
Ndinga: zinga muthu mukulu zaidi au kuwa muthu mukulu zaidi na kupata pontu ya juu zaidi (mpaka zamu {max_turns} zamu).

game_action.invalid_death: O nhoka {player_id} iafú mu ku kamba o nguzu.

outcome.all_dead_simul: O ji-anju joso ja fuile mu kithangana kimoxi.
outcome.all_dead: O ji nhoka joso ja fu.
outcome.turn_limit: Mpaka wa zamu umefikiwa - pontu bora inashinda usawa.
